requirements.case: 2159 embedded Darwin request and White response
requirements.requirement: Separate White’s library/search and book-sending response from the embedded Darwin request pasted in P6. “Vol II & IV, if in Library” is Darwin voice inside White’s body, while White’s own claim is that he can send other named books; the original full request is missing and its date is not fixed by this reply. Preserve the uncertain 1746-93 book identification, future Osbeck reading intention and trailing address.

evidence.quote: At page 688 of the “abominable” catalogue you will find Encyclopaedias.

requirements.case: 1998 copied Darwin enclosure and genus/species limits
requirements.requirement: Render the seven retained blocks as Westwood’s letter containing a copied Darwin-hand enclosure/list, not as an all-Westwood or all-Darwin document. Tellkampf’s descriptions are explicitly inadequate; Adelops is only generically identical with European species, not the same species. Preserve ditto dashes, taxon spellings, copied questions and Westwood corrections without reconstructing an institutional question or exact missing cover. Wallich’s translation is recommended because Westwood thinks Darwin has not seen it, but that is not proof of Darwin non-reading. The August 4, 1852 newspaper issue date is source bibliography, not query composition date; P7 date/address layers remain excluded from future body.

evidence.quote: The descriptions given by Tellkampf of the insects found by him in the Kentucky Cave are not sufficiently precise
His adelops is however evidently identical generically with the European species
I cannot do better than refer you to Dr Wallich’s Translation

requirements.case: 13770F discrete April 30 dates and complete ALS
requirements.requirement: Preserve 13770F as a complete two-block ALS, not a fragment by suffix. Its thirteen possible annual April 30 dates are discrete alternatives, not a continuous interval and not a unique 1856 event. Recipient identification through Dr Bakewell’s endorsement and age/address evidence remains editorial support, while the inherited malconformation report and missing original are not reconstructed. The date crosses the Origin cutoff and remains held for exact period eligibility.

evidence.quote: I beg leave to return you my very sincere thanks for your kindness

requirements.case: 2115F unaddressed financial memorandum and date-bound hold
requirements.requirement: Keep the single-block unaddressed Darwin memorandum outside ordinary correspondence dialogue. Preserve the raw TEI date bounds notBefore July 1 and notAfter August 1 rather than inventing August 1 as composition day. The body records agreed 2 percent on £250 from Ansted and Ransome, contingent company distribution and winding-up deferred to 1861; footnote investment history and its original 3½ percent are editorial, and footnote MathML must not be injected into the body. No recipient, incoming prompt or relationship is fabricated.
